subject: Data Engineering
title: Spark SQL
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Spark SQL.

hook.text: Data analysts don't want to learn Scala or Java. They want to write SQL and get results.

buildup.text: Spark SQL lets you run SQL queries directly on DataFrames and distributed datasets.

discovery.text: Under the hood, Spark SQL compiles queries through Catalyst into optimized execution plans.

twist.text: Spark SQL is so good that many teams use Spark purely as a SQL engine without writing any code.

climax.text: By speaking SQL, Spark bridged the gap between big data infrastructure and business analysis.

punchline.text: SQL on big data. Simple interface, massive power.

quiz.question: What does Spark SQL allow users to do?
options: Run SQL queries on distributed datasets
